captions.detailed: This 3D model is a wall-mountable key holder with a sleek, rounded-oblong base. It features a long, narrow slot running down the center of its top face to hold keys securely. Two countersunk mounting holes are located on either end of the slot to allow for flush screw mounting to a wall.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric wall-mounted key holder in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to configure the number of key slots, the total width and height of the holder, the gap size for the keys, and the dimensions of the mounting screws including their head diameters for countersinking.
captions.factory: The script constructs the main body by unioning a central cube with two cylinders at the ends to form a rounded oblong shape. It then uses difference operations to carve out one or more key slots modeled as cubes, using an interpolation function to distribute them. Finally, it subtracts two sets of concentric cylinders at the rounded ends to create the countersunk screw holes.
